actors.name: Péter Magyar
actors.blurb: Péter Magyar has rapidly become a defining figure in Hungary's political landscape following his recent election as Prime Minister. His actions, including demands for the resignation of President Tamás Sulyok, audits of state institutions, and negotiations with the EU, have generated significant media attention. Magyar's leadership and policy shifts are closely watched as he navigates Hungary's political and economic challenges.
